scripts.dev: bun run build:event-helper && bun run --cwd packages/tauri-app tauri:dev
scripts.build: bun run build:event-helper && bun run --cwd packages/tauri-app build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/tauri-app test && bun run --cwd packages/shared test
scripts.release: REBUILD_EVENT_HELPER=1 bun run build:event-helper && bun run --cwd packages/tauri-app release
scripts.release:dir: REBUILD_EVENT_HELPER=1 bun run build:event-helper && bun run --cwd packages/tauri-app release:dir
